name: MoMo
kurzbeschreibung:
**

MoMo in Innsbruck

** Discover the **MoMo** – the iconic **Innsbrucker Bergbahn** funicular – and enjoy breathtaking views of the **Tiroler Alpen** from the heart of the city. **

Your ride to the top

** The **MoMo** takes you from **Innsbruck’s city center** up to the **Nordkette** mountain in just **10 minutes**. With its **panoramic windows**, you’ll experience stunning vistas of the **Innsbrucker Alpen** and the **Inn Valley** along the way. **

Adventure & relaxation

** At the top station, you’ll find the **Nordkettenbahn** cable car system, offering access to **hiking trails**, **ski slopes**, and the **Hafelekar Glacier**. Whether you're into **summer hikes** or **winter sports**, the **Nordkette** has something for everyone. **

Culinary delights

** After your adventure, warm up with a **Tiroler speciality** like **Kaiserschmarrn** or a hearty **Käsespätzle** at one of the cozy mountain huts. Pair it with a **Tiroler Bier** or a **Apfelstrudel** for dessert. **

Practical info

** - **Opening hours:** Daily from **7:00 AM** to **10:00 PM** (varies by season) - **Ticket prices:** From **€12.50** (one-way) - **Tip:** Combine your **MoMo** ride with a visit to the **Alpenzoo Innsbruck** or a stroll through **Innsbruck’s Old Town**. **

Plan your trip

** Check the latest **MoMo** schedules and book your tickets online at **[www.nordkettenbahn.at](http://www.nordkettenbahn.at)**. Whether you're a **first-time visitor** or a **Tirol connoisseur**, the **MoMo** promises an unforgettable experience in the heart of the **Alps**.
